name: Agentic FoF
rootCause: BasisOS disclosed on X: “Due to a security breach, the Agentic FoF was compromised, resulting in approximately USD 531,000 in leaked funds. All vaults have now been suspended, and withdrawals from the Agentic FoF have also been paused pending the results of an internal investigation.”

descriptions.text: BasisOS disclosed on X: “Due to a security breach, the Agentic FoF was compromised, resulting in approximately USD 531,000 in leaked funds. All vaults have now been suspended, and withdrawals from the Agentic FoF have also been paused pending the results of an internal investigation.”

Agentic FoF, an Ethereum-based on-chain asset management protocol associated with BasisOS, disclosed a November 24, 2025 security breach that resulted in approximately $531,000 in losses. Publicly available evidence confirms the loss announcement and emergency pause actions, but no exploit transaction, vulnerable contract, or technical postmortem had been publicly identified at the time of writing. The precise exploit mechanism remains unknown. BasisOS stated that Agentic FoF suffered a security vulnerability that led to approximately $531,000 in losses, but no public postmortem, verified exploit transaction, vulnerable code path, or remediation commit…
